proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow/test orchestration behavior, so **ci** is primary: `.github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml`, `source-sanity.yml`, and `pccl-daily-full.yml` now resolve paired `pccl-tests` branches/revisions, pin dispatch builds by label time, add registry login for image pulls, and thread resolved revisions through build/cache/hardware validation paths. CI-owned validation tooling is updated consistently (`.github/xtest/run_cases.py`, `reconcile_results.py`, `daily_reconcile.py`, `artifact_cache.py`) to enforce archive identity with explicit `--pccl-tests-revision`; related unit/workflow-contract tests confirm that CI contract change. This outweighs incidental script mechanics because the core functional impact is run selection/identity correctness and workflow reliability.
